3: For behold, your enemies have made a noise; and they that hate you have lifted up the head.
4: Against your people they have craftily imagined a device, and have taken counsel against your saints.
5: They have said, Come, and let us utterly destroy them out of the nation; and let the name of Israel be remembered no more at all.
6: For they have taken counsel together with one consent: they have made a confederacy against you;
7: even the tents of the Idumeans, and the Ismaelites; Moab, and the Agarenes;
8: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalec; the Philistines also, with them that dwell at Tyre.
9: Yes, Assur too is come with them: they have become a help to the children of Lot. Pause.
10: Do you to them as to Madiam, and to Sisera; as to Jabin at the brook of Kison.
11: They were utterly destroyed at Aendor: they became as dung for the earth.
12: Make their princes as Oreb and Zeb, and Zebee and Salmana; [even] all their princes:
13: who said, let us take to ourselves the altar of God as an inheritance.
14: O my God, make them as a wheel; as stubble before the face of the wind.
15: As fire which shall burn up a wood, as the flame may consume the mountains;
16: so shall you persecute them with your tempest, and trouble them in your anger.
17: Fill their faces with dishonor; so shall they seek your name, O Lord.
18: Let them be ashamed and troubled for evermore; yes, let them be confounded and destroyed.
19: And let them know that your name is Lord; that you alone are Most High over all the earth.
